requirements.quote: A `FORGE:GUARD` comment from an untrusted author is ignored by `collectGuards`, `guardIssue` and the guard index.
A test covers both a trusted and an untrusted guard.
Must land before #4693's guard gate moves from shadow to enforce.

deliverables.change: import isTrustedIssueComment from ./prefilter.mjs; in guardIssue compute the `existing` guard only from trusted comments; in collectGuards skip comments that are not trusted before parseGuard. The index and guardgate use collectGuards, so they are covered.

add authorAssociation OWNER to existing guard comment fixtures; add tests: collectGuards keeps a trusted guard and drops an untrusted (CONTRIBUTOR/NONE) one; guardIssue ignores an untrusted planted guard and still posts the real one; the guards list index excludes the untrusted guard.

preserve.what: guardIssue stays idempotent for a trusted existing guard and posts exactly one guard (bin/lean/guards.mjs:96)
collectGuards signature and return shape, consumed by bin/lean/guardgate.mjs:30 and bin/stats/compounding.mjs:150
The FORGE:CONTRACT lookup in guardIssue is unchanged (out of scope)

decisions.choice: Reuse isTrustedIssueComment from prefilter.mjs rather than a new predicate; no change to the gh query because gh's comments JSON already includes author and authorAssociation
decisions.justification: bin/lean/prefilter.mjs:54-58,199 and the same use in bin/engine-cli.mjs:2033, bin/lean/postdeploy-monitor.mjs:32

repro_test.id: collectGuards ignores a FORGE:GUARD comment from an untrusted author
repro_test.command: node --test bin/lean/guards.test.mjs --test-name-pattern="collectGuards ignores a FORGE:GUARD comment from an untrusted author"
